title: Prevent worker-bundle redeploy from poisoning in-flight change-workflows (Temporal Worker Versioning + deploy-safe rollover)
success_hint: Root prevention for TMPRL1100 poisoning (P2, sibling of Fix poisoned recovery reachability). advance plugin has NO Temporal Worker Versioning (worker.ts Worker.create has no buildId/useVersioning/workerDeploymentOptions) and scripts/deploy-local.sh bounce_deployed_temporal_workers SIGTERM->SIGKILLs the worker at 2s grace mid-replay on every commit touching plugin/src/temporal/. Recent commits (PhasePlan #225) shifted the command sequence between the 4 stable wf.patched() markers in workflows.ts, so in-flight histories fail replay (TMPRL1100). Success: deploy-safe worker rollover — e.g. Temporal Worker Versioning / deployment series so in-flight workflows keep replaying on their original build, and/or drain in-flight WorkflowTasks before terminating the old worker instead of SIGKILL-at-2s. Outcome: redeploying the plugin while changes are mid-flight no longer poisons them. Concentrated in high-volume projects (pokeedge, pokeedge-web).

title: Directive carries resolvable command-contract locator, not bare command name
success_hint: Observed 2026-07-17 (pokeedge-web session, GPT-5.6 Terra): _directive.action returned {gateId:"acceptance", command:"adv-review"} and the agent searched $codemode/lgrep for the command contract instead of reading the deployed command file, burning turns until user cancelled. Success: workflow directives resolve to an actionable contract locator — deployed command file path (e.g. ~/.config/opencode/command/adv-review.md) or inline typed packet — so non-Claude orchestrators route correctly without provider-hint reliance. Fits systemizeAdvOrchestration (typed orchestration API / MCP read surface).

title: Re-expose live peer sessions (adv_session_list / wip_state peer_sessions)
success_hint: adv_session_list and adv_wip_state.peer_sessions always return [] because tools/session listPeerSessions calls the retired listSessions() stub (state.ts: "Session registry retired with projectWorkflow"). A live Linux /proc detector (utils/peer-sessions.ts detectPeerSessions, matches by git-common-dir/project-id) exists but only emits an init-time log line. Rewire adv_session_list (and wip_state peer_sessions) to project detectPeerSessions output into the privacy-defensive schema (derive startedAt from /proc stat, worktree basename from cwd, isSelf from pid; synthesize/session-id policy). Success: adv_session_list returns live same-project OpenCode peers; peer_sessions populated; privacy projection preserved (no PID/full-path leak).

title: Ship fixChangeEnumerationStarvation task 3 (archive-view enumeration bound)
success_hint: archive-inclusive reads (adv_status view:health/hygiene, adv_change_list cold cache, adv_worktree_cleanup mode:archived_branches) time out at the 10s tool ceiling on high-archive projects (pokeedge, pokeedge-web, advance) because terminal-history enumeration is unbounded. Task 3 (terminal-history.ts renderTerminalHistory + summary.v1.json sidecars, 20s history budget) is implemented on the fixChangeEnumerationStarvation change branch at release but NOT on trunk/deployed. Ship it (archive → rebuild → deploy) in a calm post-launch window (needs OpenCode restart). Also unblocks Family B routeArchivedBranchScanOff.

title: Fix archived_branches cleanup timeout
success_hint: adv_worktree_cleanup mode=archived_branches completes within the 10s tool budget on repos with 85+ archived changes: invert scan order (enumerate local change/* branches first, then per-candidate archived-status checks instead of full archived enumeration), bound/skip the unconditional git fetch on dryRun, and honor timeoutMs with partial-result reporting like mode=worktrees. Reproduced 3x on advance 2026-07-19; evidence: archived list=85 changes hydration-heavy, fetch=2.5s, cherry loop=1.1s.

title: Per-session task-queue isolation for ADV workers
success_hint: Per-session task-queue isolation for ADV Temporal workers: N live OpenCode sessions on one project currently spawn N workers on a shared task queue, saturating STSL gRPC and causing wedge/restart loops. Mitigated but not prevented by reapOrphanAdvWorkers + autoRollStaleWorkerBundle + status orphan probe (closed #217); residual amplifier remains. Implement per-session task-queue routing or per-session worker pool so gRPC saturation from concurrent sessions cannot cross-wedge. Source: #217 close-out residual gap."
